questions.q: What does an external cash transaction represent?
options: A Receivables receipt entered before the invoice
Cash activity that was never recorded within the application, such as bank fees or interest
A duplicate of an existing Payables payment
A type of bank statement file format
questions.explain: External transactions capture bank-initiated activity, like fees and interest, that has no pre-existing counterpart in a subledger.

questions.q: Where are external transactions most often created?
options: Only by Payables, never by Cash Management
Only through the Cash Forecasting work area
Automatically by the BAI2 file format itself
Directly from a bank statement line during reconciliation
questions.explain: A Cash Manager typically creates an external transaction on the spot when a statement line has no system counterpart during reconciliation.

questions.q: What must happen to an external transaction before it can be accounted?
options: It must be reconciled against the bank statement
It must be forecasted first
It must be converted to a different currency
It must be approved by Receivables
questions.explain: Like other Cash Management transactions, an external transaction must be reconciled before the Create Accounting process can post it.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what actually happens underneath a bank account transfer?
options: It creates a single internal transfer record with no accounting impact
It bypasses reconciliation entirely
It creates two external transactions: an outflow at the 'from' account and an inflow at the 'to' account
It is identical to a Receivables receipt
questions.explain: A bank transfer is built from two external transactions — an outflow on one account and an inflow on the other — covered fully in the next lesson.

questions.q: In the worked example, why was a $35.00 external transaction created for Harborview Metals Inc.?
options: To record a late Receivables receipt
To match a monthly bank maintenance fee that had no system counterpart
To reverse a duplicate Payables payment
To forecast next month's cash position
questions.explain: The bank-deducted monthly maintenance fee appeared on the statement with nothing in Oracle to match it, so an external transaction was created.
